title: Mouse lymph node colonization models predict human tumor metastasis in melanoma.
publicationName: bioRxiv : the preprint server for biology

snippet: Aggressive tumor progression and distant metastases of cancers such as cutaneous melanoma are thought to be preceded by regional lymph node (LN) infiltration.
